nodes.name: Kanye West
nodes.description: Musician; subject of the April 21, 2018 tweet that the episode anchors as a transformational event in Candace Owens' public career.

nodes.name: Mike Cernovich
nodes.description: Commentator; author of an April 2018 tweet thread on cosmic "energy shift" referenced by the host as corroborating her and Charlie's premonitions.

nodes.name: Scott Adams
nodes.description: Commentator; subject of audio clip characterizing Kanye's April 2018 tweet as having "ripped a hole in reality."

nodes.name: Andrew Kolvet
nodes.description: TPUSA spokesperson (per on-air clip); authored the public explanation of Mikey McCoy's post-shooting actions.

nodes.name: Mikey McCoy
nodes.description: Charlie Kirk's chief of staff (per on-air references); subject of behavioral questions on September 10, 2025 and the focus of TPUSA's on-air defense.

nodes.name: Alex Marlo
nodes.description: Breitbart News; subject of on-air clip dismissing conspiracy allegations against Mikey McCoy and characterizing online speculation as addictive.

nodes.name: Frank Turek
nodes.description: Former U.S. Navy officer, Christian apologist; subject of on-air clip defending Mikey McCoy and rebuking Candace for advancing unevidenced claims.

nodes.name: Rob McCoy
nodes.description: Pastor; subject of George Webb audio clip and the on-screen military-connections chart. Father identified as Roy Edgar McCoy (naval captain, assistant chief of staff for psychological warfare).

nodes.name: Brigitte Macron
nodes.description: Spouse of Emmanuel Macron (transcribed by host as "Breijit Mcronone"); subject of French tax-form reporting cited as showing "Jean Michelle" male registration.

nodes.name: Nathan Livingstone
nodes.description: Operator of "Milk Bar TV" account; subject of host's account of book-club content reuse and copyright strike.

nodes.name: David Horowitz
nodes.description: Activist; referenced on air as initial conduit between Candace and Kanye post-April 2018 tweet.

nodes.name: John Mappin
nodes.description: UK-based donors (spelling uncertain per transcript); identified on air as facilitators of the December 2018 UK event where Candace first met her husband. Name uncertainty flagged.

nodes.name: Lee Trotter
nodes.description: Surgeon referenced on air as having worked on Charlie Kirk; host alleges Air Force residency at Keesler Air Force Medical Center and possible active Air Force service.

nodes.name: Deidra Weiss Amaro
nodes.description: Medical examiner referenced on air; host alleges Army rank of major and Ericsson family lineage tied to Boyd Corporation.

nodes.name: Roy Edgar McCoy
nodes.description: Naval captain (deceased, per context); father of Rob McCoy; host alleges service as assistant chief of staff for psychological warfare in the Navy.

nodes.name: Jacob Blank
nodes.description: Signatory of the UVU Hospital internal message restricting access to the Charlie Kirk trauma file.

nodes.name: George Webb
nodes.description: Investigative journalist; subject of on-air audio clip providing commentary on Rob McCoy's military background and NAR/Ziklag connections.

nodes.name: UVU Hospital Charlie Kirk Medical File Access Question
nodes.description: Persistent question raised by host's receipt of an internal UVU Hospital message (A-1278.1) restricting file access and by tipster claims that Kirk was treated at UVU rather than Timpanogos.

nodes.name: TPUSA Military-Personnel Network
nodes.description: Persistent question regarding the density of U.S. military-background personnel inside TPUSA and adjacent media (host frames as "military simulation" hypothesis). Supported by A-1279.1, A-1282.1.

nodes.name: Mikey McCoy Behavior Discrepancy (September 10, 2025)
nodes.description: Persistent discrepancy between TPUSA's explanation (A-1275.1) of McCoy's actions (ear-covering, video capture, delayed call to Erica) and the host's behavioral analysis of the same video.

nodes.name: Susie Wiles Eulogy-Selection Question
nodes.description: Host's flagged curiosity regarding the selection of Susie Wiles (spelled "Susie Wiles" in one place) as a Kirk eulogist; no artifact-anchored explanation given.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Deceased founder of Turning Point USA; subject of financial concerns expressed one week before his death; subject of the assassination investigation.

nodes.name: Erika Kirk
nodes.description: Widow of Charlie Kirk, discussed in episode as new CEO/chairman of TPUSA. Host defends her against public criticism of fundraising emails.

nodes.name: Spencer Cox
nodes.description: Utah Governor Cox, referenced for declaring the investigation concluded and the suspect in custody, after which the feds contacted the rooftop witnesses on September 15.

nodes.name: Tyler Bowyer
nodes.description: TPUSA figure the host questions over X posts, security-adjacent roles, and timeline overlaps with Erika Kirk.

nodes.name: Susie Wiles
nodes.description: White House chief of staff. Host questions her Kirk eulogy and names her in Epstein-file situation-room meetings.

nodes.name: Candace Owens
nodes.description: Host; target of paid clipping and DoD-adjacent smear; satirizes Candyland nanny comments; organizes tip intake.

claims.label: Candace framed Kanye's then-forthcoming book "Break the Simulation" as a Blexit-aligned target on April 13, 2018
claims.claim: In the April 13, 2018 text exchange (A-1270.1), Candace tells Charlie that Kanye West was writing a philosophy book titled "Break the Simulation" and explicitly tags him "Blexit AF."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange (carrier records, device forensics).

claims.label: Charlie described Kanye as his "soul brother" and pledged to reach him in April 2018
claims.claim: Charlie's reply in the April 13, 2018 text exchange states he loves Kanye and "will find a way to him" with a promise to do so.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange and any subsequent contact logs between Charlie and Kanye representatives.

claims.label: On the evening of April 20, 2018 Charlie framed the moment as "on the brink of something big"
claims.claim: Charlie's April 20, 2018 evening text states he is running while blasting Kanye West and that "we're on the brink of something big and like this is our time."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange and corroborating device or carrier records.

claims.label: Charlie and Candace reacted with shock to Kanye's April 21, 2018 tweet
claims.claim: The April 21, 2018 morning text exchange shows Candace "shaking" and Charlie writing "I am freaking the f out."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange and timestamps.

claims.label: Mike Cernovich publicly discussed a cosmic "energy shift" in mid-April 2018
claims.claim: Mike Cernovich posted a series of tweets around April 16, 2018 stating that high-consciousness people were reporting a paradigm-level energy shift that began two-to-three weeks earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copies of Cernovich's tweet thread (Wayback Machine, third-party archives) to verify wording and dating.

claims.label: Candace concurs with Cernovich's "energy shift" framing
claims.claim: Host asserts that Cernovich's tweets confirmed her and Charlie's contemporaneous experience of the same shift.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and timestamp any other contemporaneous public statements or private messages corroborating the "energy shift" framing.

claims.label: Kanye West publicly praised Candace Owens on April 21, 2018
claims.claim: Kanye West posted "I love the way Candace Owens thinks" on April 21, 2018.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copy of original Kanye tweet from independent platform (e.g., Wayback Machine, X data export).

claims.label: Scott Adams characterized Kanye's tweet as reality-altering
claims.claim: Scott Adams, in commentary played on air, stated Kanye "ripped a hole in reality with seven words" and "freed a lot of people from a mental prison."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and timestamp original Scott Adams video; verify exact wording against played clip.

claims.label: Candace stated in the December 2018 UK Q&A that Hitler was not a nationalist
claims.claim: In audio played on air, Candace states Hitler "was a national socialist" but argues he was not a nationalist because "he wanted to globalize."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original full Q&A video, confirm context of the audience question and any prior question framing.

claims.label: Andrew Kovett states Charlie drilled an emergency-call protocol into Mikey McCoy
claims.claim: In TPUSA audio played on air, Andrew Kovett states Charlie repeatedly instructed Mikey that "If anything ever happens to me, you call Erika," and that Mikey followed that protocol after the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether Mikey McCoy himself has publicly corroborated Kovett's account, and obtain any contemporaneous record of the alleged instruction.

claims.label: Andrew Kovett states Mikey McCoy was capturing social video, not on the phone, at the moment of the shot
claims.claim: Kovett states Mikey was taking social-video clips for the TPUSA group chat at the time of the shot, with the phone in his hand only as he covered his ears due to the loud blast.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full video clip from which Kovett's narration derives, and time-stamp Mikey's actions frame-by-frame.

claims.label: Alex Marlo characterizes online conspiracy allegations against Mikey McCoy as akin to drug/pornography addiction
claims.claim: In Breitbart audio played on air, Alex Marlo characterizes suggestion that Mikey McCoy was part of a conspiracy to murder Charlie as "vile" and likens the mindset fueling such claims to drug or pornography addiction.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify date and outlet of Marlo's full segment; obtain full unedited clip.

claims.label: Frank Turk defends Mikey McCoy and rebukes Candace for advancing unevidenced claims
claims.claim: Frank Turk states there is a "difference between a possibility and evidence for a possibility," tells critics without evidence to "shut up," and characterizes Mikey McCoy's actions on September 10, 2025 as heroic given his age (23) at the time.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify date and outlet of Turk's full segment; confirm Mikey McCoy's age at the time of the September 10 event.

claims.label: A UVU Hospital internal message restricted access to a Charlie Kirk trauma file to two named individuals
claims.claim: Host displays a UVU Hospital internal message dated September 10, 2025 (received per host at 20:08) instructing staff that only "Deborah" and "Jacob Blank" are allowed to access the trauma-patient chart.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the message (forensic metadata, screenshots from multiple UVU staff); identify the two named individuals and their institutional roles.

claims.label: A Charlie Kirk medical file existed at Utah Valley Hospital on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: Host asserts that tipsters from UVU medical staff have confirmed that Charlie was admitted/entered into UVU's system, and that the internal memo at A-1278.1 corroborates the file's existence there.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification from UVU medical staff or institutional records; reconcile with the contemporaneous routing to Timpanogos Regional Hospital.

claims.label: Rob McCoy has a U.S. Navy background traceable to his father Roy Edgar McCoy
claims.claim: George Webb states on air that Rob McCoy has a "strange military background" and was guiding Charlie toward a NAR-aligned apostolic movement; host asserts Rob McCoy's father Roy Edgar McCoy was a naval captain and assistant chief of staff for psychological warfare in the Navy.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Roy Edgar McCoy's official Navy service record; confirm Webb's claim against public biographical sources.

claims.label: The McCoy orbit is tied to the NAR-aligned Ziklag donor network
claims.claim: George Webb states on air that Rob McCoy was connected to the New Apostolic Reformation (NAR) donor network Ziklag, described as "$25 million and above" Christian-right donors.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of Ziklag's donor list and any documented overlap with TPUSA personnel or events.

claims.label: Brigitte Macron is registered on French tax forms as "Jean Michelle" male
claims.claim: Host cites reporting, attributed to a French government official named Mr. Burme, that Brigitte Macron's French tax account lists her name as "Jean Michelle" and sex as male.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original French reporting, the Burme statement, and any tax-form documentation referenced; verify the dating of the records.

claims.label: Candace rejects the official "hacker" explanation for the Macron tax-form discrepancy
claims.claim: Host rejects the public suggestion that the "Jean Michelle" entry was the product of a hacker, arguing the risk/reward of hacking a sitting president's records solely to change a name entry is implausible.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and obtain the original reporting cited by host; obtain French government statement (if any) addressing the discrepancy.

claims.label: Nathan Livingstone publicly complained after being issued a copyright strike for re-uploading Book Club content
claims.claim: Host states Nathan Livingstone ("Milk Bar TV") re-uploaded Book Club content watermarked with his own branding, and after being issued a copyright strike publicly complained that Candace was trying to silence him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copies of Livingstone's tweet and the original watermarked re-upload; verify the platform's copyright-strike record.

claims.label: Host discussed David Horowitz in Book Club / network context
claims.claim: Host discusses David Horowitz in episode narrative (register anchor).
claims.investigative_direction: Tie to primary on-screen artifact in a follow-up pass if needed.

claims.label: Host discussed John Mappen / Arena Mappen in Macron thread
claims.claim: Host discusses John Mappen (Arena Mappen / Nina variants) in Macron-related segment.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain on-screen citations from the Macron segment.

claims.label: Dr. Lee Trotter cited in medical / hospital thread
claims.claim: Host references Dr. Lee Trotter in medical-report discussion (register anchor).
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference hospital message artifacts.

claims.label: Dr. Deidra Weiss Amaro cited in UVU hospital message thread
claims.claim: Host references Dr. Deidra Weiss Amaro in UVU trauma-file discussion (register anchor).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify spelling against hospital records if released.
